prompt: How many users are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users

prompt: How many users are from the UK? (country = 'UK')
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE country = 'UK'

prompt: List each distinct product category. Return one column called category.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products

prompt: Names and prices of all products in the 'electronics' category. Return name and price.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics'

prompt: What is the average price across all products? Round to two decimals. Return one column.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products

prompt: How many orders were placed in August 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-08-01' AND order_date < '2024-09-01'

prompt: What is the largest single quantity ordered in any order line?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(quantity) FROM orders

prompt: Names of users in country 'DE'. One column called name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM users WHERE country = 'DE'

prompt: List each distinct country in the users table.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM users

prompt: Names of products that cost less than 10. One column called name.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price < 10

prompt: How many orders has each user placed? Return user name and order count, one row per user. Include only users with at least one order.
gold_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name

prompt: What is the total revenue across all orders? Revenue per order line is quantity * product price. Round to two decimals. Return a single value.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id

prompt: Total revenue by product category, rounded to two decimals. Return category and total.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS total FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.category

prompt: The three products that generated the most revenue, in descending order of revenue. Return product name and total revenue rounded to two decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3

prompt: How many orders have been placed by UK users in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.country = 'UK'

prompt: What is the average revenue per order line, rounded to two decimals? Each row in the orders table is one line.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.quantity * p.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id

prompt: Names of users who have placed zero orders. One column called name.
gold_sql: SELECT u.name FROM users u WHERE u.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders)

prompt: How many orders were placed in each month of 2024? Return month (as YYYY-MM string) and count, ordered by month ascending. Use SUBSTR(order_date, 1, 7) for the month.
gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

prompt: How many products are in each category? Return category and count.
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY category

prompt: Names of users whose total spend (sum of quantity * price) exceeds 200. One column called name.
gold_sql: SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name HAVING SUM(o.quantity * p.price) > 200

prompt: For each user that has placed at least one order, return user name and the date of their first order. Two columns: name, first_order.
gold_sql: SELECT u.name, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.name

prompt: Country whose users have the highest total spend across all orders. Return one row with country and total spend rounded to two decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT u.country, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS total FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY u.country ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

prompt: Total revenue per country and per product category, rounded to two decimals. Return country, category, and total revenue. Skip combinations with no orders.
gold_sql: SELECT u.country, p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS total FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY u.country, p.category

prompt: Names of users who have ever bought a product in the 'electronics' category. Each name appears at most once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.category = 'electronics'

prompt: Names of products that have never been ordered. One column called name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM orders)

prompt: Total revenue from orders placed in Q4 2024 (October, November, December), rounded to two decimals. One value.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

prompt: The product (by name) that has been ordered the second-most times by order-line count. Return one row with name and the line count.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

prompt: Average total spend across UK users (only counting users who placed at least one order). Total spend is sum of quantity * price across that user's order lines. Round to two decimals. Return one value.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(spend), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(o.quantity * p.price) AS spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE u.country = 'UK' GROUP BY u.id)

prompt: For each product category, the share of total revenue (percentage). Return category and share rounded to one decimal place. Total revenue across all categories should sum to 100.0 (modulo rounding).
gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(quantity * price) / (SELECT SUM(o2.quantity * p2.price) FROM orders o2 JOIN products p2 ON p2.id = o2.product_id), 1) AS share FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY category

prompt: Which month (YYYY-MM) had the highest total revenue? Return the month and its revenue rounded to two decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY month ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1
